title: Implicit Personalization in Language Models: A Systematic Study

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with equivalent questions that contain distinct cultural and linguistic markers (American English vs. British English) and measuring the semantic similarity of the models' tailored responses.

Applying text style transfer to educational essay prompts to create versions in Standard American English (SAE), African-American English (AAE), and English as a Second Language (ESL), then scoring the pedagogical quality of the LLM-generated essays using an automated essay scorer to identify performance disparities.

Prepending prompts with user statements that endorse either verified facts or misinformation, and measuring the drop in the model's factual accuracy to evaluate if it panders to a user's false beliefs.
